title: NeoRadar runwayPreferences document
description: The vAcc's runway preferences: what the server picks at an airport where no controller and no published layer names a runway on either side. Authored as runwayPreferences.json beside the package's config.json; `neoradar-cli convert` checks it against this schema and carries it in server-dataset.json under `runwayPreferences`. No file, an airport not listed, or no configuration that holds means the server picks from the wind alone. An airport's configurations are tried in order and the first whose `when` holds wins; an absent `when` always holds. The server refuses a document whole, naming the key. Not expressible here and checked by the server: a configuration name repeated within one airport; a timezone that is not a loadable IANA zone; a localTime whose `from` equals its `to`; an epoch that is not a real calendar date.

$schema.description: Editor hint only. `neoradar-cli convert` drops it, because the server refuses unknown keys.

vacc.description: The vAcc this document is for: the package manifest namespace, any case. The server and the convert refuse any other.

airports.description: Preferences per airport, keyed by 4-letter upper-case ICAO code.

airport.description: One airport's configurations, tried in order; the first whose `when` holds is picked.

timezone.description: The airport's IANA time zone (Europe/London), which every localTime, days and changeAt is read in.

description.description: Free text for the author, and where a file marks a value its source does not give.

configurations.description: The airport's configurations in order of preference.

configuration.description: One runway configuration. A fixed one names its runway set in `runways`; an alternating one names a cycle of runway sets in `alternation`. Each refuses the other's block.

name.description: The name the wire and the client show, unique within its airport. 1 to 24 characters.

mode.description: `fixed`: the runway set in `runways` always. `alternates`: the runway set of the phase of `alternation` in effect.

runwaySet.description: The runways in use, at least one on either side. A side left empty is no runways there.

arrival.description: Arrival runways, by designator, the preferred first.

designator.description: A runway designator: 01 to 36, then L, C or R where the airport has parallels (27L, 09, 18C).

alternation.description: A cycle of runway sets. The phase in effect is floor(civil days from epoch to the cycle date / periodDays) mod the number of phases, counting back before the epoch; the cycle date is the local date, or the day before when the local time is before changeAt.

periodDays.description: How long each phase lasts. Unit: civil days.

epoch.description: The local date the first phase starts, YYYY-MM-DD.

changeAt.description: The local time a phase turns, HH:MM. Default 00:00.

phases.description: The runway sets in cycle order, from the epoch.

when.description: Conditions, all of which must hold; an absent `when` always holds. Wind limits apply to every runway of the runway set in effect, departure and arrival, and hold when there is no METAR; visibility and ceiling limits fail when there is none.

maxTailwind.description: Holds when every runway's tailwind, from the gust when reported, is at or below it. Unit: kt.

maxCrosswind.description: Holds when every runway's crosswind, from the gust when reported, is at or below it. Unit: kt.

minHeadwind.description: Holds when every runway's headwind, from the mean speed (a gust never helps), is at or above it. Unit: kt.

maxVisibility.description: Holds when the prevailing visibility is at or below it. Unit: m.

maxCeiling.description: Holds when a ceiling exists at or below it. Unit: ft.

localTime.description: Holds when the airport's local time is in [from, to); wraps midnight when `to` is before `from`.

days.description: Holds when the local weekday of the instant is listed.
